tei:div.tei:p: "!# bka' brgyad yang gsang thugs kyi me long las: yang gsang sgrub pa'i las byang bar chad kun sel zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ kun bzang dpal chen he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo: bka' brgyad thugs kyi me long 'di: bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: ma 'ongs skal ldan rnams kyi don: bka' brgyad khro mkhar chen mo las: khol du phyungs nas yang zab bkod: rtse lung gtsug lag khang la sbas: thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: ྈྈྈྈ de las byung ba'i las rim gyi: phrin las bar chad kun sel la: sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo: dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni: skyabs 'gro sems bskyed yan lag bcu: bka' bsgo mtshams bcad brda sgo dbye: mchod rdzas byin gyis brlab dang bdun: gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni: dkyil 'khor lha bskyed spyan 'dren dang: bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul dang: bstod pa 'dzab bsnyen rnam pa bdun: gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni: tshogs las bsgral dang chad mdo dang: brtan skyong rta bro bsdu chog dang: bkra shis smon lam rnam pa bdun: las rim nyi shu rtsa gcig go: dang po skyabs su 'gro ba ni: hūm̐: dag pa gnyis ldan chos kyi sku: nges pa lnga ldan longs spyod rdzogs: ma nges don mdzad sprul pa'i sku: bdag dang 'gro kun skyabs su mchi: shes rab gsum ldan bla ma rje: tshogs gnyis don ldan yi dam lha: bar chad kun sel mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: bdag dang 'gro kun skyabs su mchi: rkang gnyis gtso bo sangs rgyas dang: zhi ba chags bral dam pa'i chos: tshogs gsog zhing gyur dge 'dun la: bdag dang 'gro kun skyabs su mchi: gnyis pa sems bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: bdag gzhan 'gro ba kun don du: yang gsang bla med dkyil 'khor 'dir: bka' brgyad lha tshogs bsgrubs nas ni: gang la gang 'dul phrin las kyis: log 'dren bgegs rnams tshar bcad nas: gzhan don bsgrub par sems bskyed do: gsum pa yan lag bcu pa ni: hūm̐: gsang ba bla med dkyil 'khor 'dir: bka' brgyad lha tshogs gnas 'dir gshegs:

nyi zla pad steng ro gdan bzhugs: lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul: sdig pa mi dge ci bgyis bshags: dge ba bsgrubs la rjes yi rang: bla med gsang sngags chos 'khor bskor: mya ngan mi 'dar gzhan don bzhugs: dge ba byang chub thob phyir bsngo: bla med chos sku thob par shog: ces tshogs gsag par bya: bzhi pa bka' bsgo ba'i rim pa ni: bgegs gtor phyir phul la: bdag nyid dpal chen po bsgom: dung 'bud: rnga drag tu brdung zhing: nga ro dbyangs bcas 'di skad do: hūm̐: gsang ba bla med dkyil 'khor du: log 'dren bar chad bgegs kyi tshogs: rnam rtog gzung 'dzin 'khrul las byung: rang las skye zhing rang la sdig: 'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du dengs: gal te 'gro bar mi byed na: kun bzang thugs rje'i 'od zer las: snang srid dpal chen sku ru gsal: khyod rnams lus ngag yid gsum ni: rdul phran bzhin du rlog par byed: de bas 'di ru ma 'dug par: sngon 'gro'i gtor ma 'di khyer la: rang rang gnas dang rten la gshegs: oṃ sum bha ni sogs hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags kyis bskrad cing bgegs gtor byin no: lnga pa mtshams bcad pa ni: hūm̐: bdag nyid dpal chen thugs ka nas: 'od zer mtshon cha phyogs bcur 'phros: rdo rje dbyug pa gri gug dang: ral gri 'khor lo rnam lnga ste: gur chen ye shes me phung 'bar: phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad kun mtshams bcad: oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa phe laṃ shaṃ ka tsakra tīk+ṣa ṇa dz+wa la raṃ: de nas khro bo rol pa'i mtshams bcad ni: hūm̐: dregs pa lha chen phyogs skyong bsnol ba'i steng: che mchog la sogs dpal chen khro rgyal tshogs: gar dgu'i tshul gyis hūm̐ sgra sgrog: bar chad 'byung po rdul du rlog: oṃ badz+ra kro dha sarba sa ma ya ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭaḥ drug pa brda sgo dbye ba ni/ hūm̐: snang srid thams cad gzhal yas khang: gzugs snang thams cad he ru ka:

ma rig gnyis 'dzin sgo bcad pas: rang gsal ye shes 'char sgo phyes: bh+rūm̐ pra be sha ya phaṭa: brtathatanargab: bdun pa brda phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐: rang byung ye shes sems kyi lha: ma rtogs rang ngo ma shes pas: ye nas 'grogs kyang zhal ma mthong: rang gsal brda yis phyag 'tshal lo: oṃ shrī he ru ka a ti pū ho: pra tīts+tsha ho: ྈྈྈྈ dam bca' ba ni: hūm̐: dus gsum rgyal ba bka' brgyad lha: bskal pa sngon nas yi dam lha: da lta gnyis med rang ngo shes: da ni mi 'dor rtse gcig bsgrub: oṃ badz+ra tsit+ta sa ma ya hūm̐: byin 'beb pa ni: hūm̐: chos dbyings ye shes pho brang nas: skye med dbyings las ma g.yos kyang: longs sku rigs lnga dpal chen tshogs: sprul sku dpal gyi lha ru gsal: thugs dam dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs: ye shes lnga yi dbang mchog skur: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol: gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor byin phob cig: oṃ badz+ra shrī kro dha de wa sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ: ḍā ki nī sa ma ya: ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: ā be sha ya a ā: mchod rdzas byin rlabs ni: oṃ swa bhā wa bi shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa bhi shud+dho3 haṃḥ gis stong par sbyang: phyi mchod byin rlabs ni: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐: ces sogs/ shab+da āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya āḥhūm̐: gtor ma byin rlabs ni: oṃ badz+ra ma hā ba liṃ ta te dzo ba liṃ ta bha la bha te gu h+ya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrī thā: rak+ta byin rlabs ni: oṃ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥthā: bdud rtsi byin rlabs ni: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛta hūm̐ hrīḥthā: bshags pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong dgongs: bskal pa sngon nas da lta thug gi bar: ma rig dbang gis bag med ci bgyis pa: rang gnong 'gyod pa'i sems kyis mthol lo bshags: oṃ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra sa ma ya shud+dhe ā: de yan chad sngon 'gro'i rim pa'o: gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa las:

dang po gzhal yas khang lha bskyed ni: hūm̐: chos dbyings spros bral de bzhin nyid: phyogs mtshams med par kun tu brdal: de bzhin kun snang ting 'dzin gyis: 'gro drug sems can snying rjes bsgral: de las rgyu yi ting nge 'dzin: hūm̐ ni thams cad bskyed bya'i rgyu: thams cad skyed pa'i rgyu gsal bsgom: oṃ ma hā shūn+ya tā dz+nyā na dharma dhā tu bi shud+dhe maṇ+ḍal hūm̐: hūm̐: bskal pa gsum gyis 'jig rten stong: ye nas dag pa'i ngang nyid las: kun bzang yum gyi mkha' klong nas: snod bcud sbyong phyir 'byung rim brtsegs: e yaṃ raṃ ra suṃ keṃ bh+rūm̐: e: skye med stong pa'i nam mkha' la: yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor steng: raṃ las me dpung dmar nag klong: ra las rak+ta'i rgya mtsho 'khyil: suṃ las zhing chen sa gzhi brdal: keṃ las rus pa'i ri rab steng: bh+rūm̐ las dur khrod gzhal yas khang: zla gam ye shes 'char sgo'i dbus: chos sku 'gyur med e ru gsal: de steng thod pa skam rlon gyi: rtsig pa ba gam mdzes pa la: lha chen ka ba klu chen gdung: gza' brgyad ka zhu zhing chen thog: rgyu skar dral lcam thod pa'i bad: rgyu ma'i drwa phyed tsit+ta'i phod: mi ro'i rgyal mtshan keng rus 'phan: rta babs chos 'khor gser gdugs mdzes: gru chad bar khyams sgo khyud rdzogs: phyi nang med par kun tu gsal: pho brang gzhal yas gling chen dgu: 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi mu khyud bcas: mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i steng: dregs pa pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan: rang rang dkyil 'khor so sor gsal: bh+rūm̐ bhi shwa bi shud+dhe bha ga wān: dz+nyā na e tsakra maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ bh+rūm̐: ru dra kro ti ti ra baṃ: ma sūr+ya maṇ+ḍa la: a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍa la: paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍa la: hūm̐: rgyu yi yi ge gdan la bab: dkyil 'khor dbus kyi lte ba la: bdag nyid dpal chen he ru ka: mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa: zhabs bzhi gyad kyi 'dor stabs bgrad:

g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing zhal: rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan thugs srog hūm̐: spyan gsum zhal bgrad mche ba gtsigs: g.yas kyi phyag gsum rdo rje 'dzin: g.yon gyi phyag gsum bhan+dha 'dzin: dur khrod chas brgyad sku la brgyan: gnam zhal yum mchog kun bzang sbyor: zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog mthing: g.yas pas gtso 'khyud kha ṭ+wāṃ bsnams: g.yon pas dung dmar gtso la stob: yab yum sbyor ba'i thugs ka nas: thams cad bskyed pa'i yi ge spro: bskal pa'i me dpung klong na bzhugs: oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro dha shrī he ru ka ma hā kro dhī shwa ri s+t+waṃ: hūm̐: dpal chen yab yum thugs ka nas: phyogs bzhi mtshams bzhi'i dkyil 'khor du: mthing nag hūm̐ yig bcu drug 'phros: khrag 'thung yab yum 'khor bcas bskyed: hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐: shar du badz+ra he ru ka: dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing zhal: rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan thugs srog gsal: g.yas gsum rtse dgu kha ṭ+wāṃ rnga: g.yon gsum dril bhan rgyu zhags bsnams: yum chen kro dhī shwa rī sbyor: g.yas pas gtso 'khyud kha ṭ+wāṃ bsnams: g.yon pas chags pa'i dung dmar stob: dur khrod chas brgyad sku la brgyan: rigs bzhi sprul pa'i 'khor bcas gsal: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐: lho ru 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed: dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing zhal: rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan thugs srog gsal: g.yas gsum be con ral gri s+t+wa: g.yon gsum sdigs mdzub mdung bhan dmar: yum mchog za byed be tā sbyor: g.yas pas gtso 'khyud kha ṭ+wāṃ bsnams: g.yon pas chags pa'i dung dmar stob: dur khrod chas brgyad sku la brgyan: rigs bzhi sprul pa'i 'khor bcas gsal: oṃ badz+ra ya mān+ta ka ha na ma tha bhañdza hūm̐ phaṭa:

hūm̐: nub tu dbang chen rta mchog dpal: dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad: g.yas dkar g.yon ljang dbus dmar zhal: rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan thugs srog gsal: g.yas gsum rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ zhags: g.yon gsum dril bhan lcags sgrog bsnams: yum mchog pad+ma zil gnon sbyor: g.yas pas gtso 'khyud kha ṭ+wāṃ bsnams: g.yon pas chags pa'i dung dmar stob: dur khrod chas brgyad sku la brgyan: rigs bzhi sprul pa'i 'khor bcas gsal: oṃ pad+mān+ta kṛta badz+ra kro ta ha ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐: byang du rdo rje gzhon nu ni: dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing zhal: rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan thugs srog gsal: g.yas gnyis rtse dgu rtse lnga 'dzin: g.yon gnyis me dpung kha ṭ+wāṃ bsnams: mtha' gnyis ri rab phur pa 'dril: yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs sbyor: g.yas pas gtso 'khyud kha ṭ+wāṃ bsnams: g.yon pas chags pa'i dung dmar stob: dur khrod chas brgyad sku la brgyan: rigs bzhi sprul pa'i 'khor bcas gsal: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐: shar lho bla med he ru ka: dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing zhal: rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan thugs srog gsal: g.yas gsum rdo rje khyung sbrul zhags: g.yon gsum bhan+dha zhing ga 'u: yum chen nyid bzhi bde mchog sbyor: g.yas pas gtso 'khyud kha ṭ+wāṃ bsnams: g.yon pas chags pa'i dung dmar stob: dur khrod chas brgyad sku la brgyan: rigs bzhi sprul pa'i 'khor bcas gsal: oṃ gu h+ya dz+nyā na shrī he ru ka kro dhī shwa rī hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐: lho nub rig 'dzin thod pa rtsal: zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs gnyis bgrad: sku mdog dkar dmar rus rgyan spras: rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan thugs srog gsal: g.yas g.yon rdo rje dril bu 'dzin: yum mchog rdo rje rnal 'byor sbyor: g.yas pas gtso 'khyud kha ṭ+wāṃ bsnams:

g.yon pas chags pa'i dung dmar stob: dur khrod chas brgyad sku la brgyan: rigs bzhi sprul pa'i 'khor bcas gsal: oṃ badz+ra ma hā gu ru sarba sid+dhi hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐: nub byang dregs pa kun 'dul ni: dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing zhal: rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan thugs srog gsal: g.yas gsum rdo rje lha brgyad mgo: g.yon gsum bhan dmar klu brgyad mgo: yum mchog srid pa spyi 'dul sbyor: g.yas pas gtso 'khyud kha ṭ+wāṃ bsnams: g.yon pas chags pa'i dung dmar stob: dur khrod chas brgyad sku la brgyan: rigs bzhi sprul pa'i 'khor bcas gsal: oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā sarba duṣ+ṭān hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐: byang shar stobs ldan nag po che: dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing zhal: rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan thugs srog gsal: g.yas gsum rdo rje lha brgyad snying: g.yon gsum bhan dmar klu brgyad snying: yum chen 'byung ba lnga bdag sbyor: g.yas pas gzugs khams mkha' la 'degs: g.yon pas 'dod khams sa la mnan: dur khrod chas brgyad sku la gsol: rigs bzhi sprul pa'i 'khor bcas gsal: oṃ badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭān hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐: nyi ma dang ni 'od zer bzhin: dpal chen so so'i sprul 'khor bcas: phyi rol sgo ba bzhi rnams ni: ya mān pra dz+nyān pad+mān bigha: lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril: dkyil 'khor dgu yi lha tshogs rnams: sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan cha lugs: ma 'dres yongs su rdzogs par gsal: phyi rol khor yug lcags ri la: mkha' 'gro dbang phyug ging laṅka: 'bar ma ma sring bka' sdod tshogs: bsam gyis mi khyab yongs rdzogs lha: rang byung dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams: stobs dang nus pa ldan pa'i phyir: sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis rlobs: ye shes lnga yi dbang bskur ro: oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wā ka tsit+ta badz+ra dz+nyā na pañtsa swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ:

gnyis pa spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: rnam dag chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang: kun bzang zhi khro'i lha tshogs skur bzhengs shig: srid gsum gdug pa'i tshogs rnams bsgral ba'i phyir: gnas mchog 'di ru spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: dpal chen che mchog spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: yang dag rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas: yang dag thugs kyi lha tshogs spyan 'dren gshegs: hūm̐: gshin rje rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas: 'jam dpal sku yi lha tshogs spyan 'dren gshegs: hūm̐: pad+ma rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas: pad+ma gsung gi lha tshogs spyan 'dren gshegs: hūm̐: phur pa rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas: phur pa phrin las lha tshogs spyan 'dren gshegs: hūm̐: ma mo rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas: bla med he ru ka yi lha tshogs spyan 'dren gshegs: hūm̐: rig 'dzin rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas: rig 'dzin thod rtsal lha tshogs spyan 'dren gshegs: hūm̐: 'jig rten rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas: dregs pa kun 'dul lha tshogs spyan 'dren gshegs: hūm̐: drag sngags rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas: stobs ldan nag po'i lha tshogs spyan 'dren gshegs: oṃ e ā ral+li sa ma ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥhrīṃ hrīṃ dza dza:

gsum pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐: snang srid rnam dag gzhal yas 'dir: byol song gtso brgyad nyi zla'i steng: ti ra bam chen gdan steng du: rgyal ba gtso dgu'i lha tshogs rnams: dgyes shing mi g.yo brtan par bzhugs: mos pa'i bu la zhal bstan 'tshal: sa ma ya ā be sha ya a tiṣ+ṭha lhan: bzhi pa phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐: rnam dag chos dbyings ngang nyid las: rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha tshogs la: bdag dang 'gro drug sems can rnams: lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal: a ti pu ho: pra tīts+tsha ho: lnga pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha tshogs la: phyi yi mchod pa 'bul ba ni: spyan la mchod pa'i lha 'phros pa: gzugs kyi lha mo puṣ+pe mas: lag gnyis gar bsgyur me tog 'dzin: rgyal ba mnyes phyir spyan la 'bul: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe hūm̐: snyan la mchod pa'i lha 'phros pa: sgra yi lha mo girtī mas: lag gnyis pi wang sgra bsgyur bsnams: rgyal ba mnyes phyir snyan la 'bul: oṃ badz+ra gīrtī pū dza ho: shangs la mchod pa'i lha 'phros pa: dri yi lha mo dhū pe mas: lag gnyis gar bsgyur spos me bsnams: dkyil 'khor gtso dgu'i lha la 'bul: oṃ badz+ra dhū pe pū dza ho: ljags la mchod pa'i lha 'phros pa: ro yi lha mo nai wid+yas: lag gnyis gar bsgyur zhal zas bsnams: dkyil 'khor gtso dgu'i lha la 'bul: oṃ badz+ra nai wid+ya pū dza ho: sku la mchod pa'i lha 'phros pa: reg gi lha mo na bza' mas: lag gnyis gar bsgyur lhab lhub bsnams: dkyil 'khor gtso dgu'i lha la 'bul: oṃ badz+ra spar+she pū dza ho: sku gsung thugs la lha 'phros pa: snang gsal dri ro phreng ba mas: lag gnyis gar bsgyur mchod 'bul ma: dkyil 'khor gtso dgu'i lha la 'bul: oṃ ā lo ke shab+da rā sa gan+dhe mā le pū dza ho: nang mchod 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: nang gi mchod pa 'bul ba ni: phung po khams dang skye mched dang:

māṃ sa sha chen keng rus tshil: tsit+ta snying dang nang khrol lha: rak+ta dri chen go ro tsan: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos: 'dod yon rnam lnga'i mchod pa 'bul: oṃ badz+ra kiṃ ni ri ti ma hā pañtsa pū dza ho: gsang mchod 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: gnyis med gsang mchod 'bul ba ni: dbyings dang rig pa gnyis med pa: 'khor 'das gnyis med ngang du sbyor: gnyis med rtogs pa'i byang chub sems: mkha' gsang mnyam sbyor bde ba'i rol: rgyal ba yab yum rnams la 'bul: oṃ badz+ra bho dhi tsit+ta pū dza ho: rak+ta'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: rak+ta'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni: ru dra bsgral pa'i sha khrag 'di: lcang lo bcas pa'i bhan+dhar bskyil: 'khor ba dbyings su dag bya'i phyir: dpal chen dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: oṃ ma hā rak+ta la khā hi: bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul ba ni: rang byung gdod nas rnam par dag: rigs lnga dam tshig lnga yi dngos: khyad par rmad byung bdud rtsi 'di: rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar ba'i sman: ye shes lnga rdzogs bsgrub pa'i rdzas: rgyud lnga sems can kun sgrol phyir: dug lnga sel ba'i a mṛta: dkyil 'khor gtso dgu'i lha tshogs la: rnam dag bdud rtsi'i mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs dngos grub stsol: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛta la khā hi: de nas dngos grub len pa ni: hūm̐: lce yi dam tshig rdo rje la: dam tshig chen po'i hūm̐ bsgoms te: mtheb srin thabs shes phyag rgya yis: blangs shing myang bas dngos grub thob: kā ya sid+dhi oṃ: wā ka sid+dhi ā: tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐: sarba sid+dhi hrī: gtor ma 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: ba liṃ gtor mchod 'bul ba ni: thod pa mtshan ldan snod nang du: dam rdzas rmad byung gtor chen gtams:

dpal gyi gtor ma ri ltar spungs: dkar gyi thig gdab dmar gyis bran: dza gad phud dang rak+tas bran: thams cad tshim byed mchod sbyin che: gtso dgu'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang: ma hā ba liṃ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: glu bro gar mchod 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: glu bro gar mchod 'bul ba ni: stong pa'i ngang las cir yang snang: snang ba'i mtshan nyid skye ba med: glu ni 'du 'bral med pa'i glu: bro ni bar chad 'joms pa'i bro: gar ni srid gsum 'dul ba'i gar: thams cad 'dus pa phyag rgya che: glu bro gar gyi mchod pa 'dis: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mnyes gyur cig: ma hā dz+nyā na te te hūm̐: te na te te hūm̐: dug lnga dug gsum 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: dug lnga dug gsum mchod pa ni: 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dang: nga rgyal phrag dog nyon mongs lnga: ye shes lnga dang rigs lnga'i rdzas: sbyor sgrol ting 'dzin mchod pa bzhes: dug gsum mchod pa bla med rdzas: sha khrag rus pa rnam pa gsum: ye nas sku gsum rang bzhin yin: rang grol chen por bzhes su gsol: oṃ ma hā pañtsa ma hā kiṃ ni ri ti ma hā rak+ta ma hā a mṛta pū dza ho: yang dag mchod pa ni: hūm̐: rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: yang dag mchod pa 'bul ba ni: spros med don rtogs blo yis ni: ma rtogs don dam gnas su bsgral: dus gsum rgyal ba de la mnyes: mchog gi mchod pa bla med bzhes: hūm̐ ma hā shrī he ru ka ma traṃ ru dra pra bhan tsakra hūm̐: drug pa bstod pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: skye med chos sku'i rang bzhin ni: kun bzang zag med chos kyi sku: sems can don la de bzhin gshegs: 'gyur med sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: rtsol med rang bzhin chos kyi sgra: ma 'gags rang rtsal grags stong ni: chags med skyon bral pad+ma'i gsung: 'gag med gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐:

spros pa med pa chos kyi dbyings: dmigs med rnam dag chos kyi thugs: khyab brdal chen po 'dus ma byas: 'khrul med thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: chos kyi dbyings las rang shar ba: bstsal dang stsol ba mi dmigs kyang: nam mkha' mdzod kyi cho 'phrul byung: yon tan re skong phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: chos kyi dbyings las rang shar cing: dkyil 'khor chen po'i cha bzung nas: rtog tshogs dregs pa ngang gis 'dul: phrin las rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: 'gyur med sku yi dkyil 'khor du: 'jam dpal sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: gsung mchog 'gag med dkyil 'khor du: dbang chen gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod: g.yo med thugs kyi dkyil 'khor du: yang dag thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod: yon tan lhun rdzogs dkyil 'khor du: dpal chen yon tan phyag 'tshal bstod: phrin las drag po'i dkyil 'khor du: phur pa phrin las phyag 'tshal bstod: sha khrag rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor du: ma mo rbod gtong phyag 'tshal bstod: thugs rje'i gdung 'tshob dkyil 'khor du: rig 'dzin slob dpon phyag 'tshal bstod: 'jig rten rol pa'i dkyil 'khor du: mchod bstod lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: drag sngags rol pa'i dkyil 'khor du: dmod pa drag sngags phyag 'tshal bstod: dkyil 'khor mu ran skyong mdzad pa: dpal gyi bka' sdod phyag 'tshal bstod: oṃ āḥhūm̐ na mo hṛ da ya: bshags pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: bla med dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgongs: sngon nas rang nyid rig pa'i don: ma rtogs ma rig so sor bzung: rnam dag chos sku'i klong du bshags: sa ma ya e ho shud+dhe ā: bdun pa bsnyen cing bsgrub pa ni: hūm̐: gsang ba bla med dkyil 'khor du: che mchog dpal dgu'i dbu rgyan nang: thabs shes nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan: mi bskyod rnam snang rin 'byung dang: mtha' yas don grub yab lnga la: yum chen dbyings phyug sangs rgyas spyan: mā ma gos dkar dam tshig sgrol:

rgyal ba yab yum phyag mtshan bcas: kun bzang yab yum dgyes par sbyor: sras mchog sems dpa' sems mar bcas: sprul sku thub drug mthar byed brgyad: mnyen lcugs 'khril ldem gzhon tshul can: gsal 'tsher lhun sdug gzi brjid 'bar: dbu rgyan cod pan phreng ba dang: do shal dpung rgyan se mo do: rin chen dar dpyang chas rnams rdzogs: sku ni zhi tshul mdangs dang ldan: gsung ni yang snying sngags sgra sgrog: thugs ni rang byung ye shes gsal: 'dzab kyis sku gsung thugs su bskul: spros pas stong gsum sku yis gang: sku las gsung byung sngags 'brug ldir: bsdus pas chos dbyings mkha' la thim: ma gsal bar du bskyed cing bsgom: ma 'grub bar du mi gtong ngo: oṃ ā li kā li dz+nyā na pañtsa satwa kro dha mu na ye swā hā: oṃ bho dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dz+nyā na dhā tu ā: snying po brgya stong bzlas rjes su: stong tshigs kyi mchod pa bya: hūm̐: dbus phyogs 'khor lo'i gzhal yas su: zla gam dbang chen dkyil 'khor du: byol song gtso brgyad dregs pa'i steng: thabs shes nyi zla 'od kyi dkyil: ma chags pad+ma'i ge sar la: bcom ldan che mchog he ru ka: yum ni gnam zhal dbyings phyug ma: gnyis med 'khril sbyor cha lugs ni: sgeg pa dpa' ba 'jigs su rung: rgod dang gshe 'jigs snying rje rngam: khro bo'i gar dgu drag shul ldan: sku la dur khrod chas rnams rdzogs: gsung ni rngam pa'i sgra sgrog cing: thugs ni sgrol mdzad srog dang bcas: 'dzab kyis sku gsung thugs rgyud bskul: phaṭa kyis spros pas stong gsum gang: bsdus pas gsang ba'i thugs kar thim: ma gsal bar du bskyed cing bsgom: ma 'grub bar du mi gtang ngo: oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐: ye shes lha tshogs spyan 'dren gshegs: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las bstod: bag med nyams chag 'gal 'khrul bshags:

'di yan rang gzhung yin/ 'di man chad sngags 'khor 'di bder 'dus nas blangs pa'o/ mchan/ hūm̐: shar lho nub byang phyogs dang mtshams bzhi ru: mthing ser dmar ljang gru gsum gzhal yas khang: ru dra gshin rje klu rgyal lha chen dang: ma mo dar zab dregs pa dgra bgegs dang: thabs dang shes rab nyi zla 'od kyi dkyil: ma chags pad+ma 'bar ba'i ge sar la: he ru ka dang 'jam dpal rta mchog dpal: phur pa bla med rig 'dzin dregs pa 'dul: stobs ldan la sogs yab yum sras 'khor bcas: brjid pa'i sku la dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: gsung gis snying po sgra sgrog sngags kyi sgra: thugs ni sgrol mdzad ye shes srog dang bcas: 'dzab kyi snying po rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs: a las spros pas stong gsum sku yis gang: ma gsal bar du bskyed cing 'bad pas bsgrub: ma 'grub bar du ting 'dzin mi gtang ngo: 'di yan bder 'dus nas so// mchan/ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ badz+ra ya mān+ta ka hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ ha ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ gu h+ya dz+nyā na shrī he ru ka kro dhī shwa rī hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ badz+ra ma hā gu ru sarba hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa sarba duṣ+ṭān hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭān e dza bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭa: ces zur ma nyams pa'i bzlas pa bya'o: hūm̐: yang sprul dpal chen bka' sdod rnams: bzlas brjod bsnyen pa'i mchod pa bzhes: sarba ḍā ki nī sa ma ya hrīṃ hrīṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: ces stong tshigs bya'o: bsnyen pa bdun 'bum nyi khri sbyor: rgyud bskul bya ba ni: hūm̐: bla ma rig 'dzin lha tshogs dang: mkha' 'gro chos skyong dam can dgongs: 'dir bzhugs bdag cag 'khor bcas rnams: smin grol gnyis kyis rgyud sbyangs shing: bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug 'di bzung nas: bsnyen sgrub rnam gsum mtha' ru phyin: zhi rgyas dbang drag yid bzhin gter: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol:

da ltar dngos grub mi stsol na: rgyal ba thugs rje mi chung ngam: sgrub pa'i zhag grangs thems lags so: 'dzab bsnyen kun kyang thems lags so: gtor tshogs 'byor pas bskangs lags so: thugs rje'i brtse bas rab dgongs nas: da lta nyid du byin gyis rlobs: oṃ kā ya wā ka tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐: zhes blang ngo: rjes kyi cho ga la yang bdun gyi: dang po tshogs mchod ni: bdud rtsi tshogs la gtor zhing sbyangs te: oṃ sarba dra byaṃ sho dha ni hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐: rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis: chos rnams thams cad sgyu mar rig: rig pa'i yi ge raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: raṃ las me byung dngos 'dzin bsregs: yaṃ las rlung byung bag chags gtor: khaṃ las chu byung gnyis 'dzin bkrus: oṃ dang āḥdang hūm̐ du 'phros: hūm̐ gis rnam par rtog pa sbyangs: āḥyis ye shes bdud rtsir gyur: oṃ gyis 'dod yon snang srid gang: hūm̐: rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams: ye shes tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs: gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor gnas 'dir bzhugs: lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos: mdzes snyan dri bzang ro bda' zhing: reg bde glu gar chos yid tshim: 'dod yon mchod pas thugs dam bskang: zhes skong gso'i rim pa gzhan yang bya'o: de nas tshogs phud rim gsum spros te: dang po tshogs phud 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: gsang ba bla med dkyil 'khor du: rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: 'dod yon tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol: bar pa bshags pa ni: hūm̐: sngon byung dus nas da lta'i bar: ma rig bag chags lus ngag sems: bag med tshul gyis ci bgyis pa: 'dod yon tshogs kyi mchod pas bshags: bdud rtsi bran te: hūm̐: rgyu gnyis rkyen sbyar bdud rtsi 'di: dug lnga rnam dag ye shes rdzas: dza gad dpa' bo'i phud kyis mchod: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mnyes gyur cig: sarba pañtsa a mṛta la khā hi:

tshogs tha ma ni: dgra'i liṅga hom khung du bcug la: bsgral chog bya ba ni: hūm̐: dpal chen lha tshogs dbyings nas bzhengs: las kyi pho nyas stong gsum gang: thams cad ma lus skar ltar 'khrug: zhing bcu sgrol ba'i dus la bab: lcags kyu can gyis snying nas drongs: zhags pa can gyis yan lag chings: lcags sgrog can gyis mgo lus sdoms: dril bu can gyis rdul du rlogs: mtshon cha can gyis snying nas gzir: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlogs: zhes bsgral nas bstab pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs zhal phyes shig: gnam sa tsam gyi zhal yang phyes: nyi zla tsam gyi spyan yang gzigs: gangs ri tsam gyi mche ba gtsigs: glog dmar tsam gyi ljags skyod la: dgra bgegs bsgral pa'i sha rus 'di: zhal du bstab bo kha raṃ khā hi: ma hā māṃ sa la khā hi: ma hā tsit+ta la khā hi: ma hā go ro tsa na la khā hi: ma hā ba su ta la khā hi: ma hā kiṃ ni ri ti la khā hi: ma hā rak+ta la khā hi: zhes 'bul lo: de nas tshogs 'gyed pa ni: ho: rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol: sems can tshogs gnyis myur gsag phyir: zhal zas tshogs mchod dam pa 'di: 'dod yon ma spangs longs spyod rgyan: dngos grub sna tshogs 'di las 'byung: tshogs kyi mchod pa rgyan du rol: a la la ste bzhes su gsol: sngon nas da lta yan chod du: sgrub mchog bdag cag 'khor bcas kyis: las ngan sdig sgrib ci bgyis pa: tshogs kyi 'khor los byang gyur nas: tshe dang bsod nams rab rgyas shing: rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas thob par shog:

ces drang: slob dpon gyis kham gsum bzhes nas: hūm̐: tshogs kyi 'khor lo phul ba'i bsod nams kyis: sgrub mchog mched lcam 'khor bcas rnams: mi zad gter la longs spyod cing: ka dag chen po'i sa thob shog: ces smon lam btab bo: de nas tshogs spel lo: gnyis pa lhag mchod gtang ba ni: tshogs lhag ma bsdus nas kha chus bran te: hūm̐: dang po phud kyis mi mchod du: bka' brgyad lha tshogs phud la dgyes: bar du tshogs kyis mi mchod du: mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs la dgyes: tha ma lhag mas mi mchod du: dpal chen bka' nyan lhag la dgyes: dbang phyug chen mo nyer brgyad dang: mkha' 'gro sum cu rtsa gnyis rnams: gnas bzang de ni dur khrod 'grim: gos bzang de ni g.yang gzhi gyon: skyogs bzang de ni ban+dha thogs: zas bzang de ni māṃ sa za: skyems bzang de ni rak+ta 'thung: dam tshig srung zhing mkha' la 'gro: zas su sha dang khrag la dgyes: las su gsod dang gcod la brtson: sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: sngon tshe dpal gyi bka' lung bzhin: bcol pa'i phrin las myur du mdzod: dpal gyi bka' nyan lhag sdud pa: skyes mchog ging chen bco brgyad ni: dbu la phur ral sha ra ra: phyag na gri thogs zangs se zang: ging pho dgu ni sha ra ra: ging mo dgu ni si li li: thams cad ru mtshon chems se chem: dam tshig srung zhing mkha' la 'gro: zas su sha dang khrag la dgyes: las su gsod dang gcod la brtson: sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: sngon tshe dpal gyi bka' lung bzhin: bcol pa'i phrin las myur du mdzod: dpal gyi bka' nyan lhag sdud ma: ma mo bdun dang sring mo bzhi: 'bar ma chen mo brgyad rnams dang: pho nya drug cu rtsa bzhi'i tshogs: laṅka dur khrod bdag po dang: 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gro ma: lha srin sde brgyad thams cad kyang: dur khrod rdzas la longs spyod cing: rnal 'byor kun gyi drod tshad nyul: sgrub pa po yi grogs mdzad ma:

bstan pa'i dgra bgegs gshed po che: dam tshig srung zhing mkha' la 'gro: zas su sha dang khrag la dgyes: las su gsod dang gcod la brtson: lhag ma'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: sngon tshe dpal gyi bka' lung bzhin: bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ ma hā shrī he ru ka sa ma ya de wī kro dha sarba ba liṃ ta la khā hi: oṃ āḥhūm̐ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa badz+ra a ti tra sa mu tra sa ma ye hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hrīṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ: bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo: ā ral+li dza: gsum pa thugs dam bskul ba ni: hūm̐: kun bzang gtso 'khor zhi ba'i lha: bka' brgyad gtso dgu'i lha tshogs dang: mkha' 'gro chos skyong bka' sdod rnams: ma g.yel thugs dam rgyud bskul lo: dbus phyogs 'khor lo'i rtsibs steng nas: dpal chen gtso 'khor thugs dam bskul: shar phyogs 'khor lo'i rtsibs steng nas: yang dag lha tshogs thugs dam bskul: lho phyogs 'khor lo'i rtsibs steng nas: gshin rje'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskul: nub phyogs 'khor lo'i rtsibs steng nas: dbang chen gtso 'khor thugs dam bskul: byang phyogs 'khor lo'i rtsibs steng nas: phur pa'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskul: shar lho 'khor lo'i rtsibs steng nas: rbod gtong lha tshogs thugs dam bskul: lho nub 'khor lo'i rtsibs steng nas: rig 'dzin lha tshogs thugs dam bskul: nub byang 'khor lo'i rtsibs steng nas: mchod bstod lha tshogs thugs dam bskul: byang shar 'khor lo'i rtsibs steng nas: drag sngags lha tshogs thugs dam bskul: dkyil 'khor mu ran skyong byed pa: dpal gyi bka' sdod thugs dam bskul: ma nyes dpang du dkon mchog bzhugs: dgra bgegs ma gtogs sku zur cig: bka' brgyad lha tshogs dmag dpung bcas: bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod: oṃ badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭān bigh+nāṃ e hur thum dza: zhes thugs dam bskul lo: bzhi pa chad mdo bya ba ni: hūm̐: sngon tshe 'das dus bskal pa dang po la:

'og min dga' ldan zhes bya'i pho brang du: bcom ldan dpal chen che mchog he ru kas: snang srid ma mo dam la btags pa'i tshe: kau rī la sogs gnas kyi ma mo brgyad: siṃ ha la sogs yul gyi phra men brgyad: rta gdong la sogs ye shes sgo ma bzhis: so so'i gzugs mchog dam pa bstan nas kyang: bka' yi gtor ma len par ma chad dam: rnal 'byor tshe srog bsring bar ma chad dam: bcol pa'i phrin las bsgrub par ma chad dam: sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam las ma 'da' bar: sha khrag brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod: de 'og dus kyi bskal pa'i dbus ma la: bal yul yang le shod kyi brag phug tu: slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang: slob ma mkhas pa bi ma mi tra yis: rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: rdo rje dbyings kyi srung ma 'khor bcas kyis: so so'i gzugs mchog dam pa bstan nas kyang: bka' yi gtor ma len par ma chad dam: rnal 'byor tshe srog bsring bar ma chad dam: bcol pa'i phrin las bsgrub par ma chad dam: sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam las ma 'da' bar: sha khrag brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod: de 'og dus kyi bskal pa'i 'og rol du: bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag tu: slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang: slob ma'i dam pa rje 'bangs grogs gsum gyis: yang gsang zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: sgrub pa bka' brgyad dam can yongs 'dus nas: so so'i gzugs mchog dam pa bstan nas kyang: bka' yi gtor ma len par ma chad dam: rnal 'byor tshe srog bsring bar ma chad dam: bcol pa'i phrin las bsgrub par ma chad dam: sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam las ma 'da' bar: sha khrag brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod: de 'og dus kyi bskal pa'i tha ma la:

rnga yab gling phran zangs mdog dpal ri'i rtser: slob dpon chen po pad+ma thod phreng dang: rdzogs chen sngags 'chang pad+ma gling pa yis: yang gsang bla med dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: dregs pa sde brgyad mkha' 'gro chos skyong gis: so so'i gzugs mchog dam pa bstan nas kyang: bka' yi gtor ma len par ma chad dam: rnal 'byor tshe srog bsring bar ma chad dam: bcol pa'i phrin las bsgrub par ma chad dam: sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam las ma 'da' bar: sha khrag brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod: dgra bgegs nṛ tri sha trūṃ mā ra ya phaṭa: lnga pa brtan ma skyong ba ni: gtor ma phyir khyer te: bh+yo: dam la btags pa'i ma sring brtan ma'i tshogs: bdag nyid chen po rdo rje kun grags ma: dpal ldan ha ri rdo rje g.ya' ma skyong: gangs kyi yum chen rdo rje kun tu bzang: 'brog chen 'khor 'dul rdo rje bgegs kyi gtso: lhab lhub mang po dar chen na bza' dang: rin chen mang po'i rgyan chas rab tu spras: rol mo mang po'i sgra dang bcas nas ni: bdud mo chen mo bzhi ru grags pa yang: dam rdzas bka' yi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: sha med gangs dkar rdo rje g.yu sgron ma: kha rag khyung btsun rdo rje dpal gyi yum: gser chen mkha' lding rdo rje klu mo dang: rma ri rab 'byams rdo rje drag mo rtsal: lhab lhub mang po dar chen na bza' dang: rin chen mang po'i rgyan chas rab tu spras: rol mo mang po'i sgra dang bcas nas ni: gnod sbyin chen mo bzhi ru grags pa yang: dam rdzas bka' yi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod: kong btsun de mo rdo rje bod khams skyong: btsan la rog mo rdo rje sman gcig ma: g.yu yi dril bu rdo rje zu le ma: sman btsun ug chos rdo rje g.ya' mo bsil: lhab lhub mang po dar chen na bza' dang:

rin chen mang po'i rgyan chas rab tu spras: rol mo mang po'i sgra dang bcas nas ni: sman btsun chen mo bzhi ru grags pa yang: dam rdzas bka' yi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod: brtan ma bcu gnyis sman phran 'bum dang bcas: bran g.yog 'khor bcas gtor ma 'di longs la: rnal 'byor bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod: ma ma hrīṃ hrīṃ ba liṃ ta la khā hi: drug pa gtor mnan bya ba ni: gtor gzhong kha sbubs pa'i 'og tu bstan pa'i ru dra mnan par bsams la: rang dpal chen por bskyed pa'i nga rgyal gyis: hūm̐: kun bzang yum lnga'i mkha' dbyings su: zhing bcu tshang ba'i lnga phung la: bka' brgyad gtso dgu'i bro brdungs pas: nyon mongs dug lnga gtan nas 'joms: dpal chen he ru ka yi bro brdungs pas: gti mug ru dra gtan nas brlag: badz+ra he ru ka yi bro brdungs pas: zhe sdang dgra bo rdul du brlag: 'jam dpal gshin rje'i bro brdungs pas: nga rgyal dgra bgegs rdul du brlag: dbang chen gar gyi bro brdungs pas: 'dod chags dgra bgegs rdul du brlag: rdo rje gzhon nu'i bro brdungs pas: phrag dog dgra bgegs rdul du brlag: bla med he ru ka yi bro brdungs pas: dga' brod bdud rnams rdul du brlag: rig 'dzin thod rtsal bro brdungs pas: 'khor ba'i bdud rnams rdul du brlag: dregs pa kun 'dul bro brdungs pas: nyon mongs bdud rnams rdul du brlag: stobs ldan nag pos bro brdungs pas: 'chi bdag bdud rnams rdul du brlag: dpal gyi 'khor tshogs bro brdungs pas: bstan pa'i mthar mnan cho ga rdzogs: oṃ laṃ āḥlaṃ hūm̐ laṃ s+t+wam+bha ya nan: dgra bgegs sarba sha trūn mā ra ya nan: de nas gtor gzhong kha yar bstan la: hūm̐: rgyal ba kun gyi sku gsung thugs: yon tan phrin las rdzogs pa'i dpal: gti mug bud+dha rdo rje la: lhun grub lha dang lha mos bskor:

dngul lam sngon po'i shing dag la: mgo bo rgya mdud rtse mo zlum: logs na lhun grub lha bkod de: btab pas lha kun 'grub par 'gyur: lhun grub lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: phrin las rnam bzhi thams cad pra sā dha ye swā hā: zhe sdang badz+ra rdo rje la: zhi ba'i lha dang lha mos bskor: shel lam dkar po'i shing dag la: mgo bo rgya mdud rtse mo zlum: logs la zhi ba'i lha bkod de: btab pas nad gdon sdig sgrib zhi: zhi mdzad lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: nad gdon sdig sgrib shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: nga rgyal rat+na rdo rje la: rgyas pa'i lha dang lha mos bskor: gser ram ser po'i shing dag la: mgo bo rgya mdud rtse gru bzhi: logs la rgyas pa'i lha bkod de: btab pas 'byor drug rgyas par gyur: rgyas mdzad lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: tshe dang bsod nams 'byor pa drug puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: 'dod chags pad+ma rdo rje la: dbang gi lha dang lha mos bskor: zangs sam dmar po'i shing dag la: mgo bo rgya mdud rtse zla gam: logs la dbang gi lha bkod de: btab pas snang srid dbang du 'du: dbang mdzad lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: khams gsum snang srid thams cad wā shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: phrag dog karma rdo rje la: drag po'i lha dang lha mos bskor: lcags sam nag po'i shing dag la: mgo bo rgya mdud rtse zur gsum: logs la drag po'i lha rnams shar: btab pas dgra bgegs thal bar brlag: drag mdzad lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: dgra bgegs 'byung po mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa: bdun pa bsdu chog bkra shis smon lam bya ba ni: hūm̐: gsang ba bla med dkyil 'khor 'dir: chos sku gshegs bzhugs mi mnga' yang: gsang 'dus bka' brgyad lha tshogs rnams: thugs rje brtse bas 'dir byon nas: rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la: dbang bskur byin gyis brlabs nas kyang: phrin las rnam bzhi'i sgor zhugs shing: sems can kun don mdzad nas kyang: slar yang skye med klong du bsdu:

de ring nyid la gshegs nas kyang: slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol: badz+ra mu: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: zhes ye shes pa dbyings la gshegs shing: dam tshig pa rang la bsdu'o: hūm̐: cho ga lhag chad gyur pa dang: ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang: bag med blos bcos ci byas pa: dkyil 'khor lha la bzod par gsol: zhes dkyil 'khor bsdu zhing: a ā i ī u ū sogs: ā li kā li tshang bar brjod: oṃ shrī he ru ka sa ma ya: ma nu pā la zhes sogs: satwa āḥhūm̐: zhes lhag chad kha bskang ngo: bsngo ba ni: bdag gzhan sgrub mchog mched lcam ma lus kyis: dus gsum dge ba ci bsags thams cad rnams: dus gsum rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs drung: rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas 'bras bu thob phyir bsngo: bkra shis ni: hūm̐: chos sku'i bkra shis ka dag gdod ma'i klong: spros bral mi dmigs khyab brdal chen po'i sku: kun bzang yab yum bkra shis gang lags pa: dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog: longs sku'i bkra shis 'og min rnam dag klong: rang gsal ma 'gag 'od kyi skur snang ba: rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas bkra shis gang lags pa: dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog: sprul sku'i bkra shis sna tshogs gang snang ba: gdul bya'i dbang gis 'gro kun 'dren mdzad pa: rig 'dzin rnams kyi bkra shis gang lags pa: dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog: yi dam bkra shis lha yi lhar gyur pa: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub gnyis stsol ba: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs bkra shis gang lags pa: dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog: rdo rje slob dpon sgrub pa'i mched lcam rnams: bsnyen dang sgrub pa las sbyor mthar phyin nas: dus gsum 'du 'bral med pa'i bkra shis gang lags pa: dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog: ces brjod smon lam ni: bdag cag skal ldan mched lcam ma lus kun: 'dren mchog rgyal po rdo rje slob dpon dang:

gsang sngags bla med dkyil 'khor drung bzhugs nas: bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin 'di yi byin rlabs kyis: ting 'dzin zas kyis rtag tu 'tsho byed cing: ring por mi thogs byang chub lam zhugs nas: 'gro kun bde chen zhing du skye ba dang: bdag gzhan gdod ma'i sa la phyin par shog: ces smon lam gdab bo: bka' brgyad yang gsang thugs kyi me long las: yang gsang 'dus pa'i las byang 'di nyid ni: bar chad kun sel phrin gzhung dam pa 'di: o rgyan chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: dpal gyi bsam yas gtsug lag khang chen du: rje 'bangs rnams kyis zhus pa'i don du bkod: ye shes mtsho rgyal nyid la gnang: bum thang rtse lung brag la sbas: ma 'ongs dus su nga yi bu: pad+ma'i ming can 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: dam rgya: ྈྈྈྈྈ ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ ces smon lam btab nas sbas pa ni/ da lta bstan zhabs lnga bdo'i dus su/ bdag blo chung pad+ma gling pas chu pho stag gi lo dpyid zla ra ba'i nya la/ rtse lung gtsug lag khang gi rgyab/ rnam snang gi sku rgyab sog pa g.yas thad kyi brag mgo nas gdan drangs pa'o// //
